rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a skilled manual craft or handicraft trade.

example.english: They make a living from handicraft, specializing in woodenware.
example.traditional: 佢以手工藝為生，專門整木器。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ji5 sau2 gung1 ngai6 wai4 saang1 zyun1 mun4 zing2 muk6 hei3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a handmade object or handicraft item rather than the craft itself.

example.english: I bought this handicraft at the market.
example.traditional: 呢件手工藝品係我喺市集買返嚟嘅。
example.jyutping: ne1 gin6 sau2 gung1 ngai6 ban2 hai6 ngo5 hai2 si5 zaap6 maai5 faan1 lai4 ge3
